build_Predictor: build a Predictor instance with config to run action recognition on video frames
run_Predictor_call: run the Predictor on a TaskInfo object to get action prediction results
build_ActionPredictor: build an ActionPredictor with config and async visualizer for prediction and visualization pipeline
run_ActionPredictor_put: run the ActionPredictor put method to predict actions and queue results for visualization
build_Detectron2Predictor: build a Detectron2Predictor wrapper to detect human bounding boxes from video frames
